sourceContract: Cursor agent hook `sessionStart` (snake_case stdin JSON), per cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks
author: otel-hook cursor provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Real key set, synthetic values. Conversation/session/generation ids are invented UUID-shaped placeholders, the workspace root is a synthetic path, and user_email/transcript_path are null rather than redacted strings so no address or home path exists to leak.

notes: Key set matches the sessionStart payloads recorded in colinsurprenant/director hack/canary/cursor-cli/findings (CLI runs 2026-07-21 and 2026-07-22; IDE run 2026-07-21), which additionally establish that composer_mode is IDE-only and that transcript_path is null at session start.
